meta.seoDescription: Eswaran S — Cyber Defense specialist, SOC Analyst L1, Blue Team operations, SIEM & Threat Detection professional based in Chennai, India.

hero.name: Eswaran S
hero.role: SOC Analyst · Blue Team · Threat Detection

paragraphs: Cybersecurity fresher with hands-on experience in SIEM platforms (Wazuh, Splunk, Sumo Logic), log analysis, incident triage, and detection rule engineering — gained through an internship at HTC Global Services and a self-built SOC home lab.

Completed TryHackMe SOC Level 1 path with demonstrated threat detection and alert investigation skills. Earned a TCS interview offer at HackQuest CTF and a PEC CTF Top 5 finish out of 100+ participants.
Seeking an L1 SOC Analyst role to contribute practical skills in security monitoring, false positive triage, IOC identification, and MITRE ATT&CK-mapped threat response.
Actively building home lab environments to simulate real-world attack scenarios and continuously expanding detection rule coverage across multiple MITRE ATT&CK stages.

projects.title: Mini SOC Lab — Wazuh SIEM
projects.shortDescription: 3-node SOC home lab built with Wazuh SIEM on Debian, simulating real-world attack scenarios and end-to-end detection, incident triage, and alert escalation workflows.
features: Architected 3-node lab: Wazuh Server (Debian) + 2 Windows 11 endpoints via VMware
Adversarial simulations from Kali Linux — recon, exploitation, and persistence TTPs
Custom Wazuh detection rules: SSH brute-force, failed auth chains, suspicious process creation
Sub-30-second MTTD on simulated attacks with real-time alert generation
Iteratively expanding MITRE ATT&CK-mapped attack scenario coverage

projects.title: Web VAPT Document Automation Tool
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack web platform to streamline VAPT documentation, software release management, and report exchange workflows with JWT auth and role-based access control.
features: JWT-based authentication and RBAC for secure user access and document management
Automated VAPT report creation, editing, exporting, and emailing workflows
REST API endpoint security testing for auth, authorization, and access control vulnerabilities
Identified and remediated security misconfigurations to strengthen application security posture
Reduced manual reporting effort for penetration testing engagements

highlights: Built foundational SOC operations competency across 6 cybersecurity domains over a 10-month structured training programme — Windows/Linux administration, network protocol analysis, SIEM concepts, incident response lifecycle, and DFIR.

Monitored and investigated security events using Sumo Logic SIEM — configured log collection pipelines, authored search queries, and built dashboards to surface anomalous authentication and lateral movement indicators.
Detected and analysed security event categories by correlating Wireshark packet captures, Sysmon telemetry, and Windows Event Log data for alert investigation and false positive triage.
Executed network reconnaissance and vulnerability assessment using Nmap and Metasploit in adversarial simulation exercises, mapping identified attack techniques to MITRE ATT&CK TTPs.
